name: SCBUILD
recent: SC Estate Builder Berhad 近期出现董事与主要股东的股权变动，包括董事经理 Loh Boon Ginn 在公开市场增持约 2.97% 股份。公司于 9 月底发布季度业绩，并公布多项企业提案及一份谅解备忘录。
notable: 董事经理 Loh Boon Ginn 于 2026 年 10 月 28 日增持 158,041,651 股普通股，占已发行股份约 2.971%。
公司于 2026 年 9 月 30 日公布截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日止季度的合并业绩。
公司于 2026 年 9 月 25 日及 29 日发布多项企业提案公告，并于 9 月 30 日公布一份谅解备忘录。
risks: 董事 Chu Wooi Siong 于 2026 年 11 月 13 日增持 3,800 股普通股，占已发行股份约 0.00007%。

recent_en: SC Estate Builder Berhad recently saw changes in directors' and substantial shareholders' interests, including Managing Director Loh Boon Ginn acquiring about 2.97% of shares in the open market. The company released quarterly results in late September and announced multiple corporate proposals and a memorandum of understanding.
notable_en: Managing Director Loh Boon Ginn acquired 158,041,651 ordinary shares, about 2.971% of issued shares, on 28 October 2026.
The company announced consolidated results for the quarter ended 31 July 2026 on 30 September 2026.
The company issued multiple proposals announcements on 25 and 29 September 2026 and a memorandum of understanding on 30 September 2026.
risks_en: Director Chu Wooi Siong acquired 3,800 ordinary shares, about 0.00007% of issued shares, on 13 November 2026.
